notes:
Changes since v0.2.161

- New selection size controls keep proportions locked when needed. Detailed Tatami designs resize more reliably and regenerate stitches automatically. Stitchfits reports when it reduces an underlay inset to fit.
- In Objects & Stitch Order, select ranges with Shift-click, toggle individual rows with Ctrl-click, and show or hide objects in bulk. Drag selected rows together or use the arrows to move them to the top or bottom.
- Optimize Selected Stitch Order compares cuts, jumps, and travel using the distance between shapes. Closest Node can sew travel before the final fill rows and finish near the next object.
- Tatami gradients offer adjustable spacing profiles and edge travel. Split a two-color gradient into independently sequenceable color passes.
- The searchable font library includes a stitch preview. Single-line Arch Up and Arch Down lettering has an editable baseline on the canvas.
- Raised Satin and the closed Outline tool add more border styles. Rounded nodes show their handles while drawing. Rulers and measurements follow the selected unit.
- Updated menus, hoop controls, print worksheet and preview zoom, offline Resource Guide, and a Stitch Player speed slider from 0.05x to 10x.

Save your designs before updating. Projects saved with split gradient passes require v0.2.168 or later.
